settings.content: We designed MB-1 to be the #1 solution for all of your metabolism needs. Whether you’re looking to support cardiovascular health, nutrient and energy metabolism, or maintain normal blood glucose and cholesterol levels, MB-1 targets it all.
We recommend consulting with your physician before combining any of our supplements with other medications.

Cautions and Warnings:

Ask a health care provider before use if you are taking prescription medications or have a liver or kidney disorder, iron deficiency, high blood pressure or glaucoma, fever, vomiting, bloody diarrhoea, severe abdominal pain. Stop use and ask a health care provider if you experience symptoms of hypoglycaemia including feelings of anxiety, dizziness, tremor, sweating, nausea, headache, or if symptoms of digestive upset (e.g. diarrhea) occur, worsen and/or persist beyond 3 days, or if you experience any new symptoms including yellowing of the eyes or skin, dark urine, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain. Do not use if you have diabetes, or if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or immune compromised (e.g. AIDS, lymphoma, patients undergoing long-term corticosteroid treatment).

Information provided on this site is for informational purposes only and is not intended to substitute for medical advice from a healthcare professional.

This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. This product is not a treatment for obesity, type 2 diabetes or other metabolic diseases. This product is not intended for individuals 18 years old or under. This product is not intended for those pregnant, trying to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. MB-1 has not been studied in combination with prescription medications or other supplements, if you have any concern about potential interactions, we recommend consulting a medical professional before taking MB-1. If you have any pre-existing health conditions, we recommend consulting a medical professional before taking MB-1.
